text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan urges implementation of all Israeli-Palestinian agreements and resumption of talks on other tracks. King calls for establishing full facts related to Israel's opening of tunnel in Jerusalem.
- King Hussein: talk of government change baseless.
- King Hussein says developments in Gaza and West Bank are painful. Holy shrines are above the issue of anyone's sovereignty over them.
- King Hussein says those who belong to peace camp are a majority.
- French President briefs king on French efforts to calm situation in West Bank and Gaza.
- King Hussein demands mechanism to monitor what happened in Jerusalem.
